question: What level is prescribed for the boon-giving hand when measured from the back?
premises: The case of a boon-giving hand is considered.
Measurement is taken from the back.
The desired level corresponds to the inner navel.
inference: If the hand is boon-giving, its position from the back is desired to be level with the inner navel.
plain_english: If it is the boon-giving hand, then from the back it is desired to be level with the inner navel.
